description: A ground-level photograph depicts a "Dense Urban fabric" area in Stockholm, Sweden. The foreground features a paved, asphalt road curving slightly to the right, flanked by grassy verges and scattered deciduous trees. In the midground, there are low-rise buildings and more green spaces with trees and fences. The background is dominated by several multi-story residential apartment buildings, predominantly with reddish-brown facades and white accents. The sky is partly cloudy. The visible caption states: "Dense Urban fabric : City: Stockholm. Cred". Based on the surrounding document context, the full credit is C. Rosén.
